CIS.1.title: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
CIS.1.objective: Actively manage (inventory, track, and correct) all enterprise assets (end-user devices, including portable and mobile; network devices; non-computing/Internet of Things (IoT) devices; and servers) connected to the infrastructure physically, virtually, remotely, and those within cloud environments, to accurately know the totality of assets that need to be monitored and protected within the enterprise. This will also support identifying unauthorized and unmanaged assets to remove or remediate.

CIS.2.title: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
CIS.2.objective: Actively manage (inventory, track, and correct) all software (operating systems and applications) on the network so that only authorized software is installed and can execute, and that unauthorized and unmanaged software is found and prevented from installation or execution.

controls.CIS.2.1: Establish and Maintain a Software Inventory

CIS.7.title: Continuous Vulnerability Management
CIS.7.objective: Develop a plan to continuously assess and track vulnerabilities on all enterprise assets within the enterprise’s infrastructure, in order to remediate, and minimize, the window of opportunity for attackers. Monitor public and private industry sources for new threat and vulnerability information.

CIS.8.title: Audit Log Management
CIS.8.objective: Collect, alert, review, and retain audit logs of events that could help detect, understand, or recover from an attack.
